mission: Quantify V550 determinicity compute/materialization cost and compare it with an authority-first sparse conditional-evidence workload without deleting required semantics.

findings.finding: V550 resolves question_use_contract before the broad determinicity suite, but then computes position_indicator_summary, secondary_indicator_summary, indicator_answer_matrix, outlier_cohort_summary, and recursive_branch_nodes unconditionally.
INDICATOR_FIELDS is a fixed 12-field generic conditioning universe.

secondary_indicator_summary_rows recomputes the same per-indicator conditional entropy, normalized MI, Cramer's V and dominant-response score family already calculated by indicator_summary_rows, then adds joint secondary-gain calculations.
indicator_answer_matrix emits a full indicator-value × response-category rectangle, including zero-count cells.

For P=12 and recursive depth D=3, the five main determinicity families have a conservative lower bound of 92 logical field/subset evaluation units per question; optional position-signature scoring raises this to 104.
assumptions: unit counts one field/subset evaluation regardless of its internal multiple passes

findings.finding: If exact terminal authority requires K=1..4 predicates and only conditional count distributions, static field-evaluation surface reduction versus E5=92 is about 98.9%, 97.8%, 96.7%, and 95.7% respectively; these are not wall-clock predictions.

Current extraction already prefetches selected response rows once per country and can harmonize the country cache once; the major waste is post-authority analytical expansion, not necessarily repeated SQL.
Response distributions are computed before allowed_as_response_distribution is checked, so disallowed distribution work can be performed then discarded.
Bridge construction serializes every row from a broad table map, including derived, position-context and disabled diagnostic lanes; bridge cost is approximately linear in upstream row cardinality.
branch_co_signature is a copy of branch_relation_co_signature and both names are bridge-mapped, creating literal compatibility duplication when populated.
The present V551 conditional compiler does not emit position_field or position_value, so it cannot itself prove preservation of an exact conditioning predicate.
Current V550 materializes determinicity rows as per-question checkpoint parquet, later combines/writes final tables, then materializes bridge rows; planned runs may additionally emit CSV mirrors.

artifact_dispositions.basis: direct response evidence may be required; current builder computes before gating
population-position prior is semantically distinct from question-conditioned response evidence
expensive predictor metrics are not needed to form conditional counts
contains closest explicit position-conditioned response-count surface
same position partitions can yield dominant-response/outlier labels without rescanning microdata
duplicates primary scoring and adds joint entropy work
provenance/eligibility remains needed; current broad row serialization is not intrinsically required

semantic_loss_findings.finding: Current V551 conditional output omits exact position predicate identity (position_field/position_value). A sparse redesign must not delete the sole predicate-bearing empirical object until a replacement schema preserves it explicitly.
Zero-support/underpowered states may be lawful evidence of absence/uncertainty; removing matrix zero cells requires an explicit sparse absence representation or a declared complete domain.

Weighted/unweighted support, response semantics hashes, source/question identity, question-use/source-structure provenance, and typed special states are non-negotiable where governed authority requires them.
Authority-first V550 extraction cannot prune questions required independently by V550J shared/joint substrate authority.

counterevidence: V550 already performs country-level shared prefetch and optional one-time harmonization, so repeated database scans are not the dominant general pathology.
position_distribution may have independent terminal value as a structural-position prior.
Recursive child-node statistics are genuinely conditional on prior splits and are not all duplicates of root summaries.
If authority requires all values of a permitted position dimension, its V×C conditional table is not safely reducible to one predicate row-set.
Typed zero-support and underpowered states cannot be represented by silent omission.
V550J joint-question requirements may keep a broader extraction union than V550's own conditional evidence.

estimated_savings.bridge_serialization: approximately linear in lawfully eliminated upstream row count; no numeric percentage without shard row counts
estimated_savings.matrix_materialization: exact-predicate sparse rows sum_a(C_qa) versus current sum_p(V_qp*C_qp); numeric percentage depends on observed cardinalities

unresolved_questions: What exact predicate object/granularity will R04/parent terminal authority require?
Is position_distribution independently required as a V3 structural-position prior and at what granularity?
Which predictor-ranking/tree/signature artifacts have accepted terminal semantic consumers?
Does any consumer rely on explicit zero-count matrix rows rather than sparse typed absence?
Which waves require both weighted and unweighted conditional distributions?
Can branch_co_signature be removed without breaking a compatibility consumer?
What are actual per-shard Q/R/V/C cardinalities and stage wall-clock shares on the exact base?
recommended_parent_actions: Establish a predicate-preserving conditional-evidence authority/schema before deleting V550 conditioned empirical rows.
Apply authority before compute and, where lawful, before respondent extraction.
Compute authorized conditional counts once and derive any still-required summaries from that count object rather than rescanning microdata.
Require explicit terminal consumers for MI, Cramer's V, secondary-gain, recursive-tree, and position-signature machinery.
Retain shared prefetch/prepared-substrate infrastructure and include V550J-required union questions.
Run the paired benchmark plan before accepting claimed runtime/disk savings.
Do not treat current V551 conditional determinicity as semantic equivalence until exact conditioning predicate identity is preserved.
